items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had a brother, Alvin Jackson who played tenor. I don't think he worked with Milt.

ctx.x: He called me up the other day and he said, “Akil Condo.” So, there are so many dates. I just don't remember all of them. I know I did a couple small band things with Baggs. We called him Baggs. He was a great player from Detroit. He had a brother, Alvin Jackson who played tenor. I don't think he worked with Milt.
Was he a bass player or a horn player.
